messages:
Rhea K: Quick report — onboarding smoke tests failing for a few customers using the Python SDK (v0.24.1). REST works fine. Saw two distinct parity issues: param casing and ephemeral auth header behavior.
Rhea K: Repro: sampleapp calls `client.verify_key(key=...)` and we get repeated 401s. Curl with header X-Redwood-Client works and returns 200.
Tom B: can you paste the exact SDK call + headers?
Rhea K: minimal repro:
```py
# python sdk
client.verify_key(key="sk_test_xxx")
```
Captured outgoing headers from the SDK (via mitmproxy):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx
User-Agent: Redwood-Py/0.24.1
# X-Redwood-Client header MISSING
```
Curl that works:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/verify \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client: sampleapp/py-1.0" \
  -d '{"key":"sk_test_xxx"}'
```
Anya V: two things: 1) Python SDK is normalizing param names to snake_case before sending, but some HTTP admin endpoints expect `modelId` or `model_id` depending on route — that causes 400s when callers pass camelCase; 2) SDK retry middleware is re-sending on 401 which causes the UI to spin and also can trigger duplicate createModel calls in some flows because the SDK doesn't expose `idempotency_key`.
Tom B: oh interesting — param-casing drift. Do we currently transform keys automatically? That was intended to help users but it looks like it breaks routes that are strict.
Anya V: yes, the adapter has a mapping layer that converts keys, but it's too aggressive. Suggestion: accept any of model/model_id/modelId/modelName and canonicalize to model_id only when the endpoint expects it. Also do not drop unknown headers — preserve X-Redwood-Client and forwarding headers.
Rhea K: agree. Also, retry policy should never retry on 401/403. It should only retry network errors + 502/503/504 and optionally 429 for idempotent ops.
ci-bot: Created ticket SDK-9983 for "py-sdk parity: param casing, header passthrough, retry policy & idempotency"
devx-bot: Linking sampleapp smoke test checklist to ticket.
Tom B: plan: (1) remove 401/403 from default retry rules; (2) add header passthrough so custom client headers survive; (3) add param aliasing for model/model_id/modelId/modelName with clear precedence; (4) expose optional idempotency_key on createModel and other write calls. I'll open small PRs for (1)+(2) and ask Anya to handle (3)+(4).
Anya V: I'll add unit tests for the aliasing and add an e2e smoke in sampleapp that asserts a 401 surfaces immediately (no retries) and that outgoing requests include X-Redwood-Client.
Rhea K: ETA? This is blocking a couple of pilot customers.
Tom B: PR for retry/header change in ~2 hours. Anya aims for param/idempotency PR by EOD. I'll marker it P0 for devex.
Rhea K: thanks — attaching HAR and mitm logs to SDK-9983. :thumbsup:
